arguments.Title: 경로 검증용 길가 장식 비활성화
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using UnityEditor; using UnityEditor.SceneManagement; using UnityEngine.SceneManagement; using System.Collections.Generic; using System.Text.RegularExpressions; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { if(EditorApplication.isPlaying) throw new System.Exception("Stop Play first"); var s=SceneManager.GetSceneByName("CampusTerrain"); if(!s.IsValid()||!s.isLoaded) throw new System.Exception("CampusTerrain not open"); var names=new List<string>{"Campus planted groves","Campus dense grove addition","Campus grass cover","Campus dense grass cover","Tree trunks and branches"}; var paths=new List<string>(); foreach(var root in s.GetRootGameObjects()) foreach(var t in root.GetComponentsInChildren<Transform>(true)) { bool decoration=names.Contains(t.name)||t.name.StartsWith("Foliage ")||(t.name.StartsWith("Stone ")||t.name.StartsWith("Grass patch ")||t.name.StartsWith("Grove tree ")||t.name.StartsWith("BroadleafTree")||t.name.StartsWith("ConiferTree")||t.name.ToLowerInvariant().Contains("bench")||t.name.ToLowerInvariant().Contains("bollard")||t.name.ToLowerInvariant().Contains("lamppost")||t.name.ToLowerInvariant().Contains("traffic cone")||t.name.ToLowerInvariant().Contains("road barrier")); if(!decoration||!t.gameObject.activeInHierarchy) continue; string path=t.name; for(var p=t.parent;p!=null;p=p.parent) path=p.name+"/"+path; Undo.RecordObject(t.gameObject,"Path validation: hide roadside props"); t.gameObject.SetActive(false); paths.Add(path); } EditorSceneManager.MarkSceneDirty(s); EditorSceneManager.SaveScene(s); System.IO.File.WriteAllLines("artifacts/high_speed_drive/disabled-roadside-objects.txt",paths); result.Log("disabledGroupsOrObjects="+paths.Count+" saved="+s.path); } }
